exempt.PouwBulk: the bulk FP8 conformance test, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of the pins' predicates, a test and not a proof

PouwBulk.why: every generated FP8 step and FP32 add, with red-team R1's 166,000 differential steps: the vectors that left the kernel when Pouw.Fp8Atom.Proofs.conformance and addConformance were narrowed to covers (29 Sep 01:10Z, granted by R1)

Pouw.Assumptions.why: a named assumption, and a definition or statement over named assumptions, reads the protocol's definitions, never a guarantee or a proof

Pouw.Guarantees.why: a guarantee is stated over the protocol's definitions with named assumptions as hypotheses, never over a proof

Pouw.Protocol.why: the protocol's definitions are trusted text: they import no assumption, guarantee or proof

Pouw.Protocol.Basic.why: probability, integer matrices and oracle programs

Pouw.Protocol.PearlC.Defs.why: Pearl-C's Π, definitions only, over Fp8Atom's definitions: the game and the named assumption read it

Pouw.SecurityProofs.Dimension.Lifting.why: the lifting worker's grid-density and slice lemmas (L2, L3) stand alone on Mathlib

reads_exempt.Pouw.SecurityProofs.PearlC.Gamma: non-vacuity witnesses; they leave the lock in @compute-accounting's lock reduction and stay as checked tests in security_proofs (plan item 1)
